## About
We started out as a courier company delivering important documents for businesses and individuals. Over the years we took on deliveries for Dallas area furniture companies, interior designers and art galleries, and that grew into the moving and delivery business we run today.
Our mission is simple: do whatever needs to be done to make your move stress-free, treat our clients like family, and give every client the best moving experience we can. No matter how big or small your move, our team is here to help.
Our neighbors have rated us 4.9 from 567 Google reviews. In town, out of town or around town, we'd love to meet you.

## Services
- In-State Moves: Across town, anywhere in the DFW Metroplex, including Plano, Frisco, McKinney, Carrollton, Fort Worth, the Mid-Cities and the Park Cities, or out to other parts of Texas.
- Long Distance Moves: Moves across the country, handled by a dedicated team from door to door.
- Commercial Moves: Moves for businesses across the Dallas-Fort Worth area.
- Specialty Moves & Deliveries: From a single piece to your home to deliveries for furniture companies, interior designers and art galleries.
- Packing & Loading: Disassembly, packing and wrapping with high-quality materials, then careful loading and unloading.
- Storage: One family told us we stored their belongings until they were ready for delivery at their new home.
- Removal of Unwanted Items: Junk removal and haul off, plus furniture donations to Genesis Women's Shelter.
- Furniture Arrangement: Boxes go to the rooms they're labeled for, and we take apart, put back together and place your furniture.

## FAQ
Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Call us at 469-375-0400 and one of our experts will put together a quote tailored just for you.

Q: Can someone come look at my home first?
A: Yes. If needed, we're happy to schedule a walk-through to better understand your move.

Q: What comes with a full-service move?
A: Disassembly, packing and wrapping, loading and unloading, removal of unwanted items, and furniture arrangement in your new home.

Phoenix was up-front about the costs, and helped me when I was sending in photos and videos of the items to be moved. After booking our estimate, I was able to text them questions about packing and changing items that we decided not to bring. Their customer service is top tier. When the movers came, they were professional, efficient, and very friendly. They packed up the whole house in a couple of hours, and made sure to wrap the fragile items. Everything was moved with extreme care. They were communicative throughout the travel days, making sure I knew exactly when they would arrive at the new place. They got to our new house in 3 days, and not only unloaded quickly, but set up our furniture in the rooms we asked them to. We were debating about where some things should go, and they offered to stay and shift things around until we were happy with the set up. I cannot give them enough praise.
